SELECT course_name AS courseName, COUNT(*) AS allCount, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(grade AS DECIMAL) >= 60 OR grade = '合格' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS failCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(grade AS DECIMAL) >= 60 OR grade = '合格' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS failRate FROM score
course_name IN ( SELECT course_name FROM score WHERE sid = #{sid} )
GROUP BY course_name ORDER BY failRate DESC
